summary: Slot 4 (the tree only): no PPO, no rollouts, no reward - the network learns its policy and value only from MCTS trees grown on its own greedy line; every simulator tick counted (ladder unit: total ticks). Eleven recipes from scratch, all FAILED the first wall (8% by 2.0B total ticks; run 5 cleared it at 0.76B); best eval 2.675. Every eval dies in the first drop under the spawn platform. The trees find the way every round (landings at 1.8%, lines to 5.9%) and the network learns their lines where they are, but cannot fly them from the start: label fixes raised greedy flights reaching the landing ramp from 7% to 52%, and none of ~2,400 stayed on it. Bench: one round of tree-label distillation took run 5's 84% policy to 8%. Reading for the user's question: the search alone finds the moves; a learner trained only on a value-free expert's labels does not become a controller - PPO, which optimises the policy's own execution, is what the hybrid's second thread is for; the tree's role is WHERE (spawns, curricula) and, beside PPO, what to prefer. Caveat: the network-in-the-search version (v12: its policy as the prior via slot 2's mix rule, its value at the leaves) was built and tested but never ran (no box within the budget pace before the round was called), so AlphaZero's own loop is untested here. One seed per recipe; late start; up to four runs shared one box.
